name: Daraja Compass
intro: You will play a 17-year-old named Amani: answer the 15 Compass questions (mostly by tapping a suggested answer), see the five-year picture it writes, turn it into one small step for this month, tick it off, print it, and check it’s all still there after a reload.

steps.do: When the app opens, a “Welcome to Daraja Compass” card is at the bottom. Tap the small link “skip the tour” at its bottom-right.
steps.see: The card asks “How do you want to start?” with “🧪 Keep the examples to play with” and “✨ Start fresh with my own”.
steps.tip: A green greeting may show at the top for a few seconds — it goes away by itself.

steps.do: Tap “✨ Start fresh with my own”. (If a box asks “Start fresh? The examples will be cleared.”, tap “OK”.) A “📍 Where are you?” screen then asks where you live (🇰🇪 Kenya / 🇺🇸 USA / 🌍 Somewhere else) — tap “🇰🇪 Kenya”.
steps.see: The page says “Where are you going?” with a big “Start my Compass →” button.
“QUESTION 1 OF 15 — What is your name?” with a “First name” box and a “Next →” button.
It lets you skip: “QUESTION 2 OF 15 — How old are you?” (the page says “Skip anything — you can come back.”)
You are back on “QUESTION 1 OF 15 — What is your name?”.

steps.do: Tap the “First name” box, type the name below, then tap “Next →”.
Type the age below, then tap “Next →”.
steps.see: “QUESTION 3 OF 15 — Where are you from, and where do you live now?” with three suggested answers you can tap.

steps.do: Tap the suggested answer “Born and raised right here”, then tap “Next →”.
steps.see: The answer drops into the box when you tap it; then “QUESTION 4 OF 15” (someone you admire) appears.

steps.do: For questions 4 to 8, tap these suggested answers, tapping “Next →” after each one: “My mother — she never gave up”, “Good with my hands”, “Fixing things”, “My own small shop”, “KES 20,000”.
steps.see: You reach “QUESTION 9 OF 15 — Marriage — do you picture it in the next five years?”

steps.do: For questions 9 to 14, tap the FIRST answer each time, then “Next →” (Yes, Yes, Renting rooms in town, Walking/matatu, Church every week…, Employ someone).
steps.see: You reach “QUESTION 15 OF 15 — Honestly — what most often stops you or slows you down?” and the button now says “Paint my picture →”.

steps.do: Tap “No capital”, then tap “Paint my picture →”.
steps.see: “Amani O'Neal, five years from now” — a paragraph saying at 22 you see yourself doing this: my own small shop, the work brings in around KES 20,000 a month, home: renting rooms in town… Then “Is that the life you want?” with “✎ Change answers” and “Yes — build my path →”.
“WALKING BACKWARD” with three sections: “💼 The work: My own small shop”, “💰 The money: KES 20,000 a month” and “🏠 The home: Renting rooms in town”, each with boxes from 5 years down to This month.

steps.do: In the first section (💼 The work), tap the last box, “This month” (it says “ONE step — specific, small, dated”), and type the step below.
steps.type: Fix two neighbors' bikes by Saturday
steps.see: Your step is in the “This month” box.

steps.do: Scroll down and tap “Save my path → my Compass”, then scroll up a little.
steps.see: Your Compass page: “GOALS MET 0 / 18”, a line about your next check-in, and under “THIS MONTH” an empty tick box beside “Fix two neighbors' bikes by Saturday”.

steps.do: Tap the tick box beside “Fix two neighbors' bikes by Saturday”.
steps.see: The box fills with ✓, the step gets crossed out, and “GOALS MET” changes to 1 / 18 with a ⭐.

steps.do: Scroll to the very top and tap the 🖨 button (top-right).
steps.see: A print preview opens showing your Compass page — “GOALS MET 1 / 18”, your bike step (crossed out because it’s done), the money math and your five-year picture — without buttons like “📲 to my list”. Tap “Cancel”.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: Your Compass page comes back with “1 / 18” and your ticked bike step.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (iPhone: swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️. Android: swipe down from the top of the screen, tap ✈️ Airplane mode). Under THIS MONTH tap the first “✎ Write it”. In “💰 The money”, type the step below in its last box (“e.g. open the savings, count the costs”), tap “Save my path → my Compass”, then turn Airplane Mode off.
steps.type: Open a savings account at the credit union
steps.see: Even with no internet, THIS MONTH now lists both your bike step (still ticked, 1 / 18) and “Open a savings account at the credit union”.
